channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, Canada, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, Canada, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 17 Aug 2026 (17 Aug to 23 Aug 2026).

  • AI Builders Fellowship 2026 (Internet Archive Canada x BC + AI)
    Internet Archive Canada (IAC) in partnership with BC + AI · deadline Closed 21 Aug 2026 · $5,000 award for one selected builder. No application fee.
